title: Accept New York for utility and cash
description: Accept New York for utility and cash. Accept because Alpha completes orange and only gives surplus utility value. The decision turns on monopoly timing and opponent threat, not printed property price.

final_action.public_message: I propose $200 cash for New York Avenue.
final_action.private_thought: Beta offered us Electric Company for New York + $120, but we don't own Electric Company. We need New York to complete orange set. Offering $200 cash seems fair and keeps our other sets intact.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses accept_trade for this offer.

Private thought identifies why accepting is not just face-value chasing.
